classReports.title: Class Report - 08 Sep 2026 — Science Intensive Review
classReports.summary: A 60-minute bilingual Science revision based on the school test notice. Gustavo worked through food and nutrients, vitamins and minerals, and the digestive system using visual review, guided recall, matching, gap-fill, reordering, sentence reconstruction and a final quiz.
classReports.teacherInsight: Primary transcript evidence shows successful supported retrieval. Gustavo repeated 'give us energy' for carbohydrates, classified foods, reconstructed the digestive route and correctly retrieved the large intestine as the site of water absorption. The lesson supports consolidation, not a claim of independent mastery of every item.

grammarOverview.title: Grammar & Language Overview (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Gustavo remains on an A1-to-A2 developmental path. Lesson 4 adds evidence that he can apply English to academic content when language is scaffolded through visual support, repetition and retrieval cycles.
focusPoints: Simple Past: emerging productive use; continue building automatic retrieval.
Past questions: repeat Did + subject + base verb in meaningful contexts.
Complete answers: convert one-word knowledge into short accurate sentences.
Academic sequencing: use first, then, next, after that and finally to explain processes.
Science sentence frames: Carbohydrates give us energy; Proteins help us grow and repair; Digestion begins in the mouth; The small intestine absorbs nutrients; The large intestine absorbs water.

teacherFeedback.title: Feedback do Professor
teacherFeedback.body: Gustavo mostrou nesta quarta aula que consegue usar o inglês não apenas para conversar, mas também como ferramenta para revisar conteúdo escolar. O melhor resultado apareceu quando o conteúdo foi recuperado várias vezes: primeiro com apoio visual e modelagem, depois em atividades de associação e organização, e finalmente em perguntas de recall. O próximo passo é observar quanto desse conhecimento ele recupera com menos ajuda após a prova, sem abandonar o desenvolvimento estrutural do inglês.

teacherFeedback.title: Teacher Feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Lesson 4 showed that Gustavo can use English not only for conversation but also as a tool for learning school content. His strongest performance appeared when information was retrieved repeatedly: first with visual support and modeling, then through matching and sequencing, and finally through recall questions. The next step is to observe how much he retrieves with less support after the test while continuing his core English development.

cumulativeImpact.title: Longitudinal Change — Lessons 1–4
cumulativeImpact.summary: Personalized communication → emerging Past Simple production → school-language consolidation → successful supported use of English for bilingual Science review. Progress is visible in participation, retrieval and functional application; CEFR level remains unchanged pending broader independent evidence.
evidence: 4/4 completed lessons confirmed: 18 Aug, 25 Aug, 01 Sep and 08 Sep 2026.

Lesson 4 primary transcript confirms Science vocabulary retrieval, digestive-system sequencing and final quiz participation.
Repeated recall and reconstruction were effective learning mechanisms for Gustavo.
The next meaningful evidence point is post-test recall and the Science test result, if shared by the family.
